title: A test: Mining-skill work for Nebula-born miners: ore of Khambalia Crystal Market into storage at Factory Belt Manufacturing Hub (one jump)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 23:16 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6 and O1, O2; rules F22, F23, F37). The Nebula home region is mined out by other players: Haven's Commerce Fields read 0 of every ore, Gold Run Mineral Fields 1 to 3 units (table fields, 23:11 UTC); the reserve's short goods lie only at Bunda Belt (carbon 1,589), which the Deep Core mission and gather-bunda-belt-platinum work. This is class-skill work: the Mining skill at the least fuel, one jump each way, the ore stored for a base or a bid that comes.
